text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel is unremarkable here: you are a man, and so is the person appointed. There's no plausible mechanism by which male panellists disfavoured you on grounds of sex. Raising it would look like grasping, and would weaken the parts of your case that actually have substance.

Your real grievance is the experience gap — 15 years versus 8 — and the vagueness of "excellent client relationships" as a deciding criterion. That's a legitimate question about whether the published selection criteria were applied consistently and transparently.

So chase the written explanation: send a dated follow-up referencing your original request, ask for the scoring against the advertised criteria, and note the two-week delay. Keep it factual and unemotional.
